audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page attributes Vex's fear-on-dash to 'Personal Space (Fear)'. Personal Space is her W — a shield that damages nearby enemies. The fear and the dash-interrupt are Doom 'n Gloom, her passive. The page also invents an ability called 'Doom Arrival' for her ultimate (it is Shadow Surge), uses 'Shadow Surge' as her lane poke (that is Mistral Bolt, Q), and contains a garbled fragment 'Shadow e'.
audit.why: enemyKit: P Doom 'n Gloom fears and interrupts dashes and marks nearby dashers; Q Mistral Bolt 8/7/6/5/4 at 1200; W Personal Space 16/15/14/13/12 at 475, shield only; E Looming Darkness flat 12s slow zone; R Shadow Surge 140/120/100 at 2000/2500/3000, missile-mark then recast dash. Every piece of sequencing advice on the page was keyed to the wrong ability, so 'commit on Personal Space's cooldown' would walk a Galio straight into the passive that actually stops him.
audit.corrected: focus.text, loading, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[1].t, report[5].t and eight content fields now name the right ability in each slot, and state that the passive interrupts dashes rather than merely fearing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart said 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer said 'Vex' on all seven.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Vex x7 and matches the content layer. The kit supports it: Doom 'n Gloom interrupts dashes, and Justice Punch is Galio's only gap-close, so she leads every lane stage. The 50.33% win rate comes from Galio winning off the map with Hero's Entrance rather than in lane, so diff stays EVEN.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side set to Vex with ratings and whys rewritten as one group. content win[N] already reads Vex on disk, so no content chart edit is included.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item row was written as a Galio spike ('your MR makes AP trades a subscription you sell') and never mentioned that Personal Space shields exactly the burst window Galio's rotation depends on.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags shield-absorbs-burst for this pair. Personal Space is a 16s shield at rank 1 — if it is up when the taunt lands, the rotation does not convert.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why and dosFull[0].d now tell you to force the 16s shield out before committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the whole 'step up on its downtime' framing pointed at the wrong ability.
audit.why: Doom 'n Gloom is a periodic empowerment whose cooldown shrinks when a nearby enemy dashes — it is not a spell with a fixed timer you can wait out.
audit.corrected: Now gives Mistral Bolt 8s to 4s at 1200, Personal Space 16s, Shadow Surge 140s, and says plainly that the passive is read by its glow, not by a timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twelve fields called Vex he/his/him, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood / tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Vex is she/her; lint flagged every instance.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bled bullets replaced with bodies that match their titles.

edits.before: Levels 1-5 are rough — Vex's Personal Space passive marks you the instant you dash near her, so every Justice Punch you throw out either eats bonus magic damage or fears you right as you land it. She can poke freely with Shadow Surge and Shadow e while you're stuck choosing between passive farming or eating a bad trade. Try to win the wave through auto-attacks and Winds of War rather than engaging, and don't waste Justice Punch just to close distance since that's exactly what she wants.
